The deliberate destruction of a national, ethnic, racial or religious group; a word created by Raphael Lemkin in 1944.

front: When was the Warsaw ghetto sealed?
back: November 1940; it held over 400,000 people at its peak.
20 January 1942: senior officials coordinated the 'Final Solution', the murder of Europe's Jews.

front: Name the six Nazi death camps in occupied Poland.
back: Chełmno, Bełżec, Sobibór, Treblinka, Majdanek, Auschwitz-Birkenau.

How did the war contribute to the Holocaust?
back: Conquest brought millions of Jews under Nazi rule, and the invasion of the USSR led to mass shootings and then death camps.

front: What was the impact of the Holocaust after 1945?
back: Survivors displaced; Nuremberg trials; Genocide Convention and UDHR (1948); remembrance on 27 January.
